question: For the Temporary Equipment Pool (SERVICE_LOANER / SALES_EVALUATION), should temporary custody/placement of a serialized asset be persisted as a NEW parallel placement record/ledger, or expressed entirely through the EXISTING governed Inventory ledger + Location model per ADR-010? Return one verdict.
claudePosition: Express temporary placement through the EXISTING governed Inventory ledger + Location model (ADR-010); do NOT introduce a parallel placement ledger or a second custody authority. A SERVICE_LOANER / SALES_EVALUATION placement is a custody state on the serialized asset carried by governed ledger effects and Inventory Location (customer Location when placed; MOBILE for a truck, VIRTUAL in transit). The Serialized Asset's single nullable currentEquipmentId plus the fail-closed concurrent-link rule already model exclusive custody. Unknown or unverified custody resolves AVAILABILITY = UNKNOWN (fail-closed), never AVAILABLE.
requirement: The verdict must respect ADR-010's single-authority principle: the Enterprise Inventory ledger is the single stock-movement authority; custody is expressed through Inventory Locations and governed ledger effects; no parallel custody store is introduced.
sourceFacts: ADR-010 L33: the Enterprise Inventory ledger remains the single stock-movement authority.
ADR-010 L36-38: trucks are MOBILE Inventory Locations; in-transit stock uses the VIRTUAL Location; serialized identity is carried by governed ledger effects.

ADR-010 L51: the Serialized Asset has one nullable currentEquipmentId; an Equipment record links to exactly one Serialized Asset; concurrent links fail closed; no transaction may leave a serial both installed and available.
deterministicEvidence: ADR-010 + DECISIONS #59 are MERGED (PR #497); Rev 6 spec FINAL — this is current, non-superseded authority.
The Temporary Equipment Pool business relationship (SERVICE_LOANER + SALES_EVALUATION) is RATIFIED; only the persistence shape is open — it is constrained by, not exempt from, ADR-010.
materialUncertainty: Whether a temporary placement warrants a distinct governed EFFECT TYPE (e.g. LOANER_OUT / EVALUATION_OUT) inside the existing single ledger, versus reusing existing Transfer / CONSUMED semantics. This is a modeling detail WITHIN the single-ledger principle, not a second store.
